description: This file contains unit tests for the 'NameTemplate' class within the 'org.openmrs.layout.name' package. It tests name formatting functionalities, including handling tokens, custom formatting, and global property configurations, using JUnit 5 testing framework.

classes.name: NameTemplateTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for testing the NameTemplate class's name formatting logic.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the NameSupport instance and configures special tokens before each test.

methods.name: shouldProperlyFormatName
methods.description: Tests formatting of a simple name with tokens to produce a combined full name.

methods.name: shouldProperlyFormatNameWithNonTokens
methods.description: Tests formatting of a name with non-token strings, including punctuation and quotes.

methods.name: shouldUseNameTemplateConfiguredViaGlobalProperties
methods.description: Verifies that name formatting can be configured via global properties and applies the configured template.
